title: SF Export Filename Mapping v1.0
description: Schema for the filename_alias mapping document that converts physical Screaming Frog export filenames to canonical report_type identifiers. Handles p_ prefix, Turkish ı/i case collision, version suffixes like (1)/-copy/_old, and whitespace/underscore variants (§6.4). Consumed by sf_import Stage 1.

normalization_rules.description: Ordered regex passes applied to raw filenames BEFORE alias matching. Lower 'order' runs first. Reference implementation lives in platinum-seo-engine/server/pipelines/filename_alias.py.

aliases.description: Filename → canonical_report_type mappings. First match wins after normalization.

reject_ambiguous_match.description: If a normalized filename matches multiple alias entries, abort the import (do not silently pick one)

require_hash_on_required_tier.description: raw_reports.file_hash must be computed for every required-tier file

rule_id.description: Unique identifier (e.g. strip_extension, lowercase, turkish_i_fold, drop_version_suffix, fold_p_prefix_to_v)

replacement.description: Python regex backreference syntax (e.g. \1, \g<name>) or literal

filename_patterns.description: Regex patterns applied to the POST-normalization filename. Anchored match (re.fullmatch) unless pattern itself includes ^/$.

expected_header_hashes.description: Known-good SHA256 header hashes across SF versions (logged for drift detection; non-match is WARN, not FAIL)

min_row_count.description: Absolute minimum row count expected (defensive sanity check)

source_prefix_hint.description: Diagnostic hint about which SF export mode typically produces this file
